evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE is the dependency scanner's directive list, and the surrounding comments describe scanning co-installed [Unit] dependency directives. It includes many [Unit] dependencies but omits PropagatesStopTo= and its inverse StopPropagatedFrom=, both recognized by systemd v257. A co-installed unit with PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service is therefore invisible to the scan, so discovery can wrongly report the selected unit as independent/supported. This is an implementation omission in existing intended behavior, not a new scope request.
